releases.title: Help shape AstraCore
changes: Explore the roadmap and see which improvements are being considered, planned, or worked on.
Signed-in pilots can suggest ideas and report bugs, with a clear preview of what will be shared publicly.
Find the project source, contribution guide, and license directly from the platform.
Follow readable release notes, with technical details available when you choose to show them.
technical: Release metadata ships with the application and is checked against the package version before publication.
Community reports have local tracking and a GitHub issue link when publication is configured and succeeds.
The source is available under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0; third-party material retains its own terms.
The planner dependency is restricted to supported PuLP 3 releases (3.3 or newer, below 4) to preserve compatibility with the existing optimizer.
limitations: The PI planner audit has identified market-liquidity and factory-restock improvements. Those changes are on the roadmap and are not included in this release.
A submitted idea is reviewed before it becomes a development commitment. GitHub publication depends on the operator's integration configuration.

releases.title: Existing PI platform baseline
changes: AstraCore already offered EVE sign-in, character management, PI planning, colony templates, and operation tracking before this release history was introduced.
technical: 1.0.0 was the existing package version. It is recorded here as a baseline, not as a newly reconstructed historical release. No original release date is asserted.
